title: 第15章 副局长驾到谁敢放肆第16章 玩归玩闹归闹别拿邪修开玩笑
content_zh:
“柳二江、尸九，两个元婴境的废物，也敢在我西开的地盘上以大欺小？”
“真当我西开无人了嘛！”
话音未落，一道壮硕的身影出现在大厅中央。
来人身高近两米，穿着一件洗得发白的旧式军装背心，露出两条肌肉虬结的胳膊。
他只是站在那里，一股血腥的杀气便弥漫开，压得在场众人喘不过气。
“程局！”
“程副局长！”
老苏、陆大有等一众749的老人，看到来人，脸上瞬间露出喜色，齐刷刷地敬礼。
柳二江和尸九的脸色却变了。
两人身体下意识地紧绷起来，如临大敌。
陈邪脚边，刚才还想冲上去干架的大白鹅，脖子猛地缩了回来。
“嘎！”
它小声对陈邪嘀咕：“小子，这家伙好重的杀气，身上的血腥味浓得呛人！是个狠人！”
陈邪心里也是一咯噔。
这人……好强！
“那是咱们西开分局的副局长，程大安。”
林小蛮凑到陈邪耳边，压低声音，语气里带着崇拜。
“听说，程局参加过立国时候的那场大战，是从战场上活下来的真大佬！”
陈邪头皮有点发麻。
怪不得杀气这么重。

程大安的出现，让原本嚣张的柳二江和尸九，气焰瞬间矮了半截。
他们可以不把江听洲放在眼里，但绝对不敢在程大安面前放肆。
这老家伙，就是个不讲道理的疯子！
当年有个魔道宗门惹了他，他一个人提着刀杀上山门，硬是把人家从宗主到杂役，砍了个干干净净！
“程……程局。”
柳二江挤出一个僵硬的笑容，拱了拱手。
“误会，都是误会。我们只是来……来和贵局的两位小辈，友好交流一下。”
“友好交流？”
程大安冷笑一声，环视一圈。
“你他妈带着长老和徒弟，堵我749的大门，这叫友好交流？”
“我怎么瞅着，是来给我拆家的呢？”
尸九那张老脸抽搐了一下，他仗着自己赶尸一脉的辈分高，强撑着开口。
“程大安，你别不讲道理！是你的手下，打伤了我徒弟在先！”
他指着陈邪，声音尖利。
“今天，这小子的修为，必须废掉！不然，我们赶尸一脉，绝不善罢甘休！”
话音刚落。
“砰！”
程大安一步踏出，脚下的花岗岩地砖瞬间龟裂，裂纹四散蔓延。
他双眼一瞪，杀气死死锁定了尸九。
“他奶奶的！”

“老子人还在这站着，你还敢提废人修为？”
“你赶尸一脉算个什么东西！也敢威胁我749？”
content_en:
"Liu Erjiang and Shijiu, two Nascent Soul Realm wastes, dare to bully the small ones in my Xikai territory?"
"I really thought there was no one around me in Xikai!"
Before he finished speaking, a strong figure appeared in the center of the hall.
The person was nearly two meters tall, wearing an old-fashioned military vest that had been washed white, revealing two muscular arms.
He just stood there, and a bloody murderous aura filled the air, making everyone present breathless.
"Cheng Bureau!"
"Deputy Director Cheng!"
When Lao Su, Lu Dayou and other 749 old people saw the person coming, their faces instantly showed joy and they all saluted.
However, the expressions of Liu Erjiang and Zhijiu changed.
The two bodies tensed up subconsciously, as if they were facing a formidable enemy.
At Chen Xie's feet, the big white goose that just wanted to rush forward to fight suddenly retracted its neck.
"Gah!"
It whispered to Chen Xie: "Boy, this guy is so murderous, and the smell of blood on his body is so strong that it's choking! He's a ruthless person!"
Chen Xie's heart also skipped a beat.
This man... is so strong!
"That's the deputy director of our Xikai Branch, Cheng Da'an."
Lin Xiaoman leaned close to Chen Xie's ear and lowered his voice with admiration in his tone.
"I heard that Director Cheng participated in the great war when the country was founded, and he was a real boss who survived the battlefield!"
Chen Xie's scalp was a little numb.
No wonder he is so murderous.
The appearance of Cheng Daan made the originally arrogant Liu Erjiang and Shijiu lose half their arrogance.
They could ignore Jiang Tingzhou, but they would never dare to be presumptuous in front of Cheng Daan.
This old guy is an unreasonable lunatic!
Back then, a demonic sect provoked him. He went up to the mountain gate with a knife and chopped off everyone from the sect leader to the handyman!
"Cheng...Cheng Bureau."
Liu Erjiang forced out a stiff smile and cupped his hands.
"Misunderstandings are all misunderstandings. We are just here...to have a friendly exchange with the two juniors from your bureau."
"Friendly exchange?"
Cheng Daan sneered and looked around.
"You brought the elders and apprentices to block the door of my 749. Is this called friendly exchanges?"
"Why am I looking at you? Are you here to demolish my home?"
Shi Jiu's old face twitched. He relied on his seniority in the corpse lineage to force himself to speak.
"Cheng Da'an, don't be unreasonable! It was your men who injured my apprentice first!"
He pointed at Chen Xie with a sharp voice.
"Today, this boy's cultivation must be abolished! Otherwise, we will never give up if we drive away the corpse lineage!"
The words just fell.
"Bang!"
Cheng Daan took a step forward, and the granite floor tiles under his feet cracked instantly, and the cracks spread in all directions.
His eyes widened and he locked onto Zhijiu with murderous intent.
"His grandma's!"
"I'm still standing here, how dare you mention the cultivation of a cripple?"
"Who do you think you are from the zombie lineage! Do you dare to threaten me 749?"
